howto.name: Paste GraphQL
howto.text: Enter a query, mutation, fragment, or selection set in compact form.

howto.name: Format the operation
howto.text: Braces, arguments, arrays, and comma-separated fields are indented in a readable shape.

howto.name: Copy the formatted query
howto.text: Paste the result into your app, GraphiQL, Apollo Studio, or pull request.

faq.q: Does it need my GraphQL schema?
faq.a: No. The formatter only structures the query text and does not introspect or validate against a schema.

faq.q: Can it format mutations and fragments?
faq.a: Yes. Queries, mutations, fragments, arguments, arrays, and nested selection sets are handled.
Yes. The GraphQL text is formatted locally in your browser.
